newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch unadjusted unemployment falls in Jan-March.
newsitem.headline: Dutch unadjusted unemployment falls in Jan-March.

text.p: Dutch non-seasonally adjusted unemployment fell to an average of 415,000 in January-March 1997 from 429,000 in December-February, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said.

NOTES - Percentages are calculated in relation to average 1996 labour force (6.681 million). By international standards, the CBS uses a narrow definition of unemployment. Figures are compiled from job centre registrations and CBS survey.
Economists polled by Reuters had expected non-seasonally adjusted January-March unemployment of 430,000 and seasonally adjusted January-March of 413,000.

The CBS said unemployment under youngsters (up to the age of 25) had decreased more than average with 62,000 youngsters unemployed during the first quarter of 1997 versus 78,000 during the first quarter of 1996.
